responsibility: Provides the core in-memory representation support routines for Graphite SCoPs, polyhedral basic blocks, and polyhedral data references. It allocates and frees scop/poly_bb/poly_dr and gimple_poly_bb objects, links them to the underlying GIMPLE basic blocks and data references, and centralizes Graphite’s debug and dump printers for domains, accesses, schedules, ASTs, contexts, parameters, and whole SCoPs through isl pretty-printing helpers. This file is the representation and diagnostics backbone of the Graphite subsystem rather than a transformation pass by itself.
